prompt:
Refine the supplied previous concept (image-3.png) using the mood board (image-1.png) for character and colours. Create a landscape 3:2 Minecraft builder reference sheet, crisp authentic vanilla Minecraft 1.21.1 voxel blocks only, skilled human builder quality, plain warm light background, no characters or animals. TWO VIEWS SIDE BY SIDE, not stacked: LEFT orthographic straight-on SOUTH front elevation showing the entire row 0–7 in order; RIGHT three-quarter view from south-east showing all eight complete buildings in the same order, at the SAME BLOCK SCALE as the left view. Fit both long rows across their respective half-width panels; leave generous vertical breathing space. Small title 'PRESIDIO / COMPACT KIT' and small numeric labels 0–7 only. No decorative landscaping outside plots. No swatch strip.

Correct the previous concept's three chief problems: overlarge high-resolution façades and tall windows instead of the requested tiny Minecraft scale; invented fine architectural parts instead of real stair/slab/trapdoor geometry; oversized landscaped platforms. Preserve the successful distinct silhouettes, white/cream/red-brick palette, red and slate roofs, porches, green shutters, chimneys, cupola and twin battery pits. Clearly show chunky countable full blocks: one storey about TWO blocks high, ordinary windows ONE block, two-storey wall bodies about FOUR blocks tall. All façades complete and framed, recessed entrances, modest projecting porches, finished side and rear walls, substantial real stair eaves/verges and slab ridges. No thin miniature brick courses masquerading as whole blocks, no custom meshes, no curved geometry.

Exact plot coordinates and limits, all bases y=0 smooth_stone one block thick only under building plus at most one-block apron, nothing outside its plot, all front entrances face south/high z. Buildings occupy their plots with roof overhang included. 0 x0..7 z0..7 max y8: 8x8 family house, two storeys, white wood/clapboard, steep brick_stairs red gable, compact front porch, brick chimney. 1 x8..17 z0..9 max y8: 10x10 cream Mission Revival duplex, two distinct front entrances, low polished_granite_stairs and polished_granite_slab hipped tile roof. 2 x18..23 z0..5 max y5: 6x6 white single-storey garage, wide segmented birch_trapdoor door, dark cobbled_deepslate_stairs gable. 3 x24..27 z0..3 max y4: 4x4 tiny white utility shed, compact dark slab roof and single birch_door. 4 x28..43 z0..13 max y9: 16x14 long two-storey red bricks barracks, white framed single-block windows, grey slate gable, south colonnade with smooth_quartz pillars and birch_fence rails. 5 x44..63 z0..19 max y10: 20x20 broad low cream Spanish Colonial Revival hall, brick_stairs red roof, squat side wings and central gable, stair-stepped smooth_sandstone_stairs arch heads and recessed glass_pane windows, small integrated bell cupola with lantern, all within height. 6 x64..75 z0..11 max y8: 12x12 two-storey white officers' house, dark green spruce_trapdoor shutters backed by green_terracotta, grey hipped roof with two tiny dormers, wide front porch. 7 x76..93 z0..23 max y5: 18x24 low Endicott coastal battery, weathered concrete, TWO octagonal stepped-block gun pits with iron_bars mounting rings, recessed south iron_door ammunition entrances, stone_brick_stairs to parapet, restrained polished_granite rust streaks, substantial terraced dirt/grass_block earth embankment on NORTH behind pits rising to parapet, all inside plot. No giant cannon barrels.

Use exact real block palette: white_concrete, birch_planks, smooth_quartz, smooth_quartz_stairs, smooth_quartz_slab, smooth_sandstone, smooth_sandstone_stairs, smooth_sandstone_slab, bricks, brick_stairs, brick_slab, brick_wall, polished_granite, polished_granite_stairs, polished_granite_slab, cobbled_deepslate, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, cobbled_deepslate_slab, spruce_trapdoor, green_terracotta, glass_pane, iron_bars, lantern, smooth_stone, smooth_stone_slab, light_gray_concrete, andesite, andesite_stairs, andesite_slab, cracked_stone_bricks, stone_bricks, stone_brick_stairs, stone_brick_slab, stone_brick_wall, birch_fence, birch_trapdoor, birch_door, spruce_door, iron_door, stone_button, dirt, grass_block, oak_leaves. Spruce trapdoors stay natural dark wood; green shutter colour comes from green_terracotta backing. No nonexistent green-painted trapdoor block. Warm lantern lighting at entrances, beneath porches, inside rooms and battery, enough to prevent spawning; discreet floor lights represented by lanterns. Only small contained leaf shrubs; cypress/eucalyptus character may appear as faint non-build reference silhouettes in the far background, not large trees on the plots. Soft daylight, clear roof readability, precise voxel edges, restrained ambient shadows. Render a practical small-scale build reference, not a grand oversized architectural model.

changes: Generated with the built-in image tool and saved as concept-2.png in the current directory.
Replaced stacked views with the requested side-by-side front elevation and three-quarter row, preserving all eight building identities.

Specified real stair, slab, fence and trapdoor parts for roof edges, arches and porches while retaining red roofs, grey roofs, chimneys, dormers and recessed openings. Some illustrated green shutters still resemble painted trapdoors; implement these with green_terracotta and natural spruce_trapdoor details.
